# RNAFlowX

### A Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline

**Author:** Sriram B

**Version:** 1.0.0

**Generated:** 13 August 2026

*Nextflow • DESeq2 • Salmon • clusterProfiler • Quarto*

</div>

# Executive Summary

RNAFlowX is a reproducible transcriptomic analysis workflow developed for **Bulk RNA sequencing**. The pipeline performs read quality assessment, transcript quantification, differential expression analysis, Gene Ontology enrichment, KEGG pathway discovery and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) within a fully reproducible Nextflow framework.

## Project Overview

**Objective**

Identify transcriptional alterations induced by PFOS exposure using a reproducible RNA-seq workflow.

**Organism:** Homo sapiens

**Quantification:** Salmon

**Differential expression:** DESeq2

**Functional analysis:** GO, KEGG, GSEA

**Report generation:** Quarto HTML
:::

::: {.section}
## RNAFlowX Workflow

| Stage | Tool | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Quality Control | FastQC + MultiQC | QC metrics |
| Preprocessing | FastP | Clean FASTQ |
| Quantification | Salmon | Transcript abundance |
| Counting | Tximport | Gene count matrix |
| Differential Expression | DESeq2 | DEG table |
| Functional Analysis | clusterProfiler | GO / KEGG |
| Gene Set Analysis | GSEA | Enrichment profiles |
| Reporting | Quarto | Interactive HTML |
:::

> **Scientific objective:** This publication summarizes the complete downstream transcriptomic analysis while preserving reproducibility and minimizing command-line content.`}
